correctness.rationale: Cyclic rim Fourier decomposition of covariance C(a) on sum-zero H gives eigenvalues (m+1)/m a(1-a), D_k(a)/m, D_k=a+(1-a)4cos²(pi k/m). Strict negative F_m'(a) proves unique root in (0,1). Direct contact leverages Rsp-Rrim=F and weighted trace=m. Weighted containment and determinant AM-GM prove global MVEE and uniqueness without restricting competitors to symmetric ellipsoids. The analytic periodic trapezoid remainder gives F_m=mI(a)+b(a)+O(m rho^m), I(1/3)=0, I'(1/3)=-3/2, b(1/3)=5/2; hence first correction 5/(3m). Independent direct orbit root/contact checks at m=3,4,5,8,24,101,501 match; finite checks do not establish the uniform complex-strip estimate.

originality.rationale: The same ordinary unsigned wheel polytope has a known Euclidean inradius/incenter result, but its inscribed ball cannot imply a minimum-volume enclosing ellipsoid, full contact design or a_m asymptotic. The published symmetric edge ROOT-polytope MVEE concerns ±(e_i-e_j), not unsigned e_i+e_j; its Fourier symbol is 4sin² not 4cos² and its optimal weights have exponential, not one-third algebraic, behavior. Classical general D-optimal/MVEE equivalences are background, not the claimed new wheel-specific explicit solution. Bounded searches found no equivalent unsigned-wheel MVEE formula.
